_comment: RINSC fixture layout in RAW frame pixels (2592x1944). The raw frame is the hanging-down view rotated 90 deg clockwise: raw top->bottom = hanging view left->right = actuators #1..#4, source on the left (author, 2026-09-30). Boxes are [x0, y0, x1, y1] around each finger AT REST; the clamp is at the right (x ~1825), the free end is the left `tip_frac`. Exposure started ~at the first clip (T0 = 2025-11-17 15:17:51). Fingers are 20x40 mm with ~38 mm hanging free; the visible 40 mm length of #3 is ~532 px at rest, so ~0.075 mm/px (fisheye: +/-10%, not undistorted).

CN9018_strip._comment_guards: y_root_hint: frame-0 root seed in raw px; the strip edge line sits at y ~1052-1058 at x_root, a wire line at ~1070 (2026-10-02). tip_inset_px: the tracked point sits this far inboard of the rest band end (the end itself jitters). root_retry_reach: when a march reaches less than this fraction of L0, re-seed the root on every dark line in the root column and keep the furthest-reaching march (2026-10-05; the chained seed latched onto a static wire line late in the campaign). Optional "march": {kwargs} overrides band_tracker.march; {"search": null, "max_shift": null, "rel_depth": null} with no y_root_hint, tip_inset_px or root_retry_reach reruns the merged-campaign code bit for bit.
CN9018_strip._comment: band_tracker line-following of the strip's lower edge from its visible root (x_root, just inside the lit diffuser; the true clamp is hidden over the frame member). Arc length fixed from each clip's rest frame (frame 0).
